SELECT
    m.EmployeeKey AS manager_key,
    concat(m.FirstName, ' ', m.LastName) AS manager_name,
    count() AS direct_report_count,
    avg(
        dateDiff(
            'day',
            toDate(parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(r.HireDate)),
            toDate('2009-12-31')
        ) / 365.25
    ) AS avg_team_hire_tenure_years
FROM retail.DimEmployee AS r
INNER JOIN retail.DimEmployee AS m
    ON r.ParentEmployeeKey = m.EmployeeKey
WHERE r.ParentEmployeeKey IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    m.EmployeeKey,
    manager_name
ORDER BY direct_report_count DESC, manager_name ASC
